ps.union-overlap.title: Union with overlap (inclusion–exclusion)
ps.union-overlap.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.union-overlap.check: Add the singles, subtract every pairwise overlap once, add back the triple overlap.

ps.sampling-no-replace.title: Sampling without replacement (one route)
ps.sampling-no-replace.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.sampling-no-replace.check: Pick one route: sequential fractions (ordered) or combinations (unordered) top and bottom — never mix.

ps.hypergeometric.title: Hypergeometric probabilities
ps.hypergeometric.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.hypergeometric.check: $\binom{K}{k}\binom{N-K}{n-k}/\binom{N}{n}$: lower numbers add to $n$, upper numbers add to $N$.

ps.at-least-one.title: 'At least one' via the complement
ps.at-least-one.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.at-least-one.check: $P(\ge1)=1-P(\text{none})$; build 'none' as a product (independent) or a ratio of counts.

ps.ordered-outcomes.title: Counting ordered dice and coin outcomes
ps.ordered-outcomes.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.ordered-outcomes.check: Dice and coins are distinguishable: 2 dice give 36 equally likely ordered pairs; (1,6) ≠ (6,1).

ps.given-restrict.title: Restrict the sample space after 'given'
ps.given-restrict.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.given-restrict.check: $P(A\mid B)=P(A\cap B)/P(B)$: the denominator becomes the 'given' event, not the whole space.

ps.independence.title: Independent vs mutually exclusive
ps.independence.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.independence.check: Independent: $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$, i.e. $P(A\mid B)=P(A)$. Disjoint with positive probabilities ⇒ dependent.

ps.total-prob.title: Total probability: weighted evidence
ps.total-prob.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.total-prob.check: $P(E)=\sum_i P(E\mid H_i)P(H_i)$: weight each branch by its prior before adding.

ps.bayes.title: Bayes: numerator branch and base rate
ps.bayes.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.bayes.check: Numerator = prior × likelihood of the branch asked about; denominator = the full weighted total.

ps.pmf-moments.title: PMF normalisation, $E[X]$ and $E[X^2]$
ps.pmf-moments.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.pmf-moments.check: Normalise over the full support first; $E[X^2]=\sum x^2p(x)$, never $(E[X])^2$.

ps.var-linear.title: Variance of $aX+b$
ps.var-linear.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.var-linear.check: $\mathrm{Var}(aX+b)=a^2\mathrm{Var}(X)$; $b$ drops out, sign of $a$ disappears; get Var from $E[X^2]-(E[X])^2$ first.

ps.model-select.title: Choosing the model and its mean
ps.model-select.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.model-select.check: Fixed $n$ independent trials → binomial; events at a rate over an interval → Poisson; no replacement → hypergeometric; wait for first success → geometric.

ps.tail-direction.title: Direction of $\le$ / $\ge$ tails
ps.tail-direction.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.tail-direction.check: Translate words first; $P(X\ge k)=1-P(X\le k-1)$ — the complement stops at $k-1$.

ps.poisson-rate.title: Poisson rate × interval and $\lambda=np$
ps.poisson-rate.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.poisson-rate.check: $\lambda$ = rate × interval length (same units); for Binomial with large $n$, small $p$, use $\lambda=np$.

ps.pdf-cdf.title: PDF normalisation and CDF intervals
ps.pdf-cdf.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.pdf-cdf.check: Integrate $f$ over its support to 1 to fix the constant; $P(a<X\le b)=F(b)-F(a)$; $f(x)$ is a density, not a probability.

ps.median-cdf.title: Median by solving $F(m)=0.5$
ps.median-cdf.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.median-cdf.check: Find $F$, set $F(m)=0.5$, solve for $m$ — do not evaluate $F(0.5)$.

ps.uniform-conditional.title: Uniform conditional probability
ps.uniform-conditional.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.uniform-conditional.check: For $X\sim U(a,b)$: $P(X\in A\mid X\in B)=\text{length}(A\cap B)/\text{length}(B)$ — divide lengths, not cut-off values.

ps.exponential.title: Exponential: $\lambda=1/\text{mean}$, memoryless, floor is geometric
ps.exponential.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.exponential.check: $P(X>t)=e^{-\lambda t}$ with $\lambda=1/\mu$; $P(X>s+t\mid X>s)=P(X>t)$; $\lfloor X\rfloor\sim$ Geometric with $p=1-e^{-\lambda}$.

ps.standardize.title: Standardising and moments of $aZ+b$
ps.standardize.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.standardize.check: $Z=(X-\mu)/\sigma$ with the SD, not the variance; $aZ+b$ has mean $b$, variance $a^2$.

ps.chi-square.title: Chi-square as a sum of squared normals; t
ps.chi-square.subject: Probability and Statistics

ps.joint-pmf.title: Joint PMF: constant, marginals, conditionals
ps.joint-pmf.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.joint-pmf.check: Sum over every cell to fix the constant; marginal = row/column sum; $p(x\mid y)=p(x,y)/p_Y(y)$.

ps.uniform-area.title: Probability by area for independent uniforms
ps.uniform-area.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.uniform-area.check: Independent uniforms → constant joint density on the rectangle; probability = favourable area / total area.

ps.total-expectation.title: Law of total expectation
ps.total-expectation.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.total-expectation.check: $E[X]=\sum_y E[X\mid Y=y]P(Y=y)$ — weight each conditional mean by its probability.

ps.descriptive.title: Mean update, median and mode
ps.descriptive.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.descriptive.check: New mean = new total / new count; median = middle of the sorted data (average the two middles if $n$ is even).

ps.cov-independence.title: Zero covariance vs independence
ps.cov-independence.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.cov-independence.check: Independent ⇒ Cov = 0; Cov = 0 does not imply independence (e.g. $Y=X^2$, $X$ symmetric). Cov ≠ 0 ⇒ dependent.

ps.clt-sum.title: Sums and means of iid variables; CLT
ps.clt-sum.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.clt-sum.check: Sum: mean $n\mu$, variance $n\sigma^2$, SD $\sigma\sqrt n$. Mean: SE $=\sigma/\sqrt n$. Standardise with the SD/SE, not the variance.

ps.ci-compute.title: Computing a confidence interval
ps.ci-compute.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.ci-compute.check: $\bar x\pm z_{\alpha/2}\sigma/\sqrt n$ ($\sigma$ known) or $\bar x\pm t_{\alpha/2,n-1}s/\sqrt n$; a NAT asks for one number (an endpoint, width or $n$), not the interval.

ps.ci-interpret.title: Interpreting a confidence interval
ps.ci-interpret.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.ci-interpret.check: $\mu$ is fixed; '95%' describes the procedure — about 95% of intervals built this way cover $\mu$. No probability statement about $\mu$ for a computed interval.

ps.test-select.title: Choosing z, t or chi-square
ps.test-select.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.test-select.check: Mean, $\sigma$ known → $z$; mean, $\sigma$ unknown (small $n$) → $t_{n-1}$; variance or count tables → $\chi^2$.

ps.test-logic.title: p-values and decision wording
ps.test-logic.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.test-logic.check: p = P(data at least this extreme | $H_0$); reject $H_0$ iff $p\le\alpha$; say 'fail to reject', never 'accept' or 'P($H_0$ true)'.

ps.estimator.title: Unbiasedness and estimator variance
ps.estimator.subject: Probability and Statistics
ps.estimator.check: Unbiased: $E[\hat\theta]=\theta$. $\bar X$ is unbiased with variance $\sigma^2/n$; $s^2$ uses $n-1$; dividing by $n$ is biased low.
